offence_note: Second degree murder of his mother
sentence_quote: I have come to the conclusion that an extended period of parole ineligibility is required and that period is 17 years' imprisonment before you are eligible to apply for parole.
note: Victim surcharge exempted; apology listed as mitigating but described as ringing somewhat hollow.

offence_note: Kidnapping, assault with a weapon, failing to comply with probation order
sentence_quote: he was sentenced to three years imprisonment in addition to credit of three years and two months for pre-sentence custody. In addition, the appellant was designated as a long-term offender; under the terms of that order he is subject to supervision for a period of eight years.
note: Prison total computed as 3 years plus 3y2m credit.

offence_note: Robbery, sexual assault and break and enter of elderly woman's apartment
note: Dangerous offender designation and indeterminate sentence set aside; new hearing ordered.

offence_note: Conspiracy to kidnap, kidnapping, possession of loaded restricted firearm
sentence_quote: it is appropriate to reduce the sentence imposed to, in effect, add a one-year sentence to his current sentence and, in the result, I will sentence him to a total sentence of six years, two months, and 10 days.
note: Credit at 1.5:1 for custody since 2011, amount not stated; consecutive to existing sentence; surcharge waived.

offence_note: Two robberies, assault, failure to appear
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to a global sentence of imprisonment of two years less a day.

offence_note: Conspiracy to transfer firearms, transferring firearms and ammunition
sentence_quote: For Count 1, the conviction for conspiracy, I sentence you to five years and 150 days. It is appropriate to give you credit at a rate of 1.5 days for the 100 days that you were in custody. That means the 'new time' is five years.
note: Joint submission; Count 5 stayed under Kienapple.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, assault with a weapon, assault causing bodily harm (youth)
sentence_quote: The judge sentenced J.S.M. to open custody for a period of 10 months and probation for 12 months
note: Youth open custody; weapons counts stayed; outcome of Crown constitutional challenge not shown in excerpts.

offence_note: Robbery, assault and breach of undertaking against domestic partner
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed consecutive sentences; two years for the robbery; four months for the assault; and two years for the breach of undertaking. The total time imposed was 2 ½ years.
note: Breach sentence stated as two years but judge's reasons say two months; total 2.5 years.

sentence_quote: The appellant was sentenced to a two year less a day conditional sentence order and one year of probation.
note: Crown sentence appeal and conviction appeal both dismissed.

offence_note: Breach of recognizance and breach of probation
sentence_quote: On June 24, 2015, he was sentenced to a suspended sentence for one year and placed on probation with a number of conditions for 12 months.
note: Both sentence appeals dismissed; only victim surcharge payment terms varied (one day default, concurrent).
